name_en: Neural response evoked by intracortical or cortical-surface electrical stimulation
name_zh: 皮层内或皮层表面电刺激诱发的神经响应
reason: No registry marker indexes the local neural response to ICMS or to visual cortex stimulation; the STM-ICMS and STM-PHOS files temporarily use MK.motor_cortical_spiking and MK.BOLD_visual_cortex as closest markers, neither of which is measured in these paradigms. MK.CCEP covers single-pulse responses at distant contacts only. Maintainer to decide whether one marker or separate somatosensory/visual markers are needed; evidence still to be searched (curator_b, sprint 6, 2026-10-16).

Afterdischarges in the ECoG are the neural signal monitored during every electrical stimulation mapping session and set the usable current (Ritaccio et al. 2018, doi:10.1097/WNP.0000000000000440); STM-ESM files temporarily use MK.CCEP and MK.high_gamma as closest markers (curator_b, sprint 6, 2026-10-16).
